nom: SOME BY MI Clear Spot Patch

avis.texte: These are better than most pimple patches I've tried. My favorite! Please keep these in stock!
Love that the patches are barely noticeable, but they did not do anything for my breakouts. In fact, some pimples got worse. I wanted to like them, but i did not :(.
They adhere well and have better absorption than competitors.
Absolutely love these. They are super thin yet work really really well!

At first, I was a little concerned about the price since it's relatively cheaper compared to higher-end brands, but I'd say it performs better than most. The patch itself pulls out the gunk, and you can actually see it being extracted. I also appreciate the patch blending in with my skin.
